source.title: Predicting Undergraduate Students’ Thriving: An Empirical Econometric and Psychosocial Investigation in Higher Education
source.status: rough draft; empirical findings reported, NOT independently replicated from participant records
source.data_access: underlying deidentified participant-level records not provided
source.study: single-site, cross-sectional undergraduate survey; private university in the US Midwest
source.notice: The repository reproduces analysis from author-supplied aggregate results. These are reported real-study statistics, not re-estimates from original microdata.

scope: Reported B, CI, beta and p are transcribed from draft tables; do not call them re-estimated.
The correlation matrix used pairwise valid N=152–156; reconstructed VIF and standardized coefficient checks are approximate.
Differences between nonsignificant and significant slopes do not establish mediation or causal pathways.
No HC3, heteroskedasticity test, influence diagnostics, MICE, causal IV, SEM, subgroup effects or out-of-sample validation can be estimated from these aggregates alone.
